positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Project leader for spacecraft test process improvement projects and spacecraft component upgrades.  Responsible for releasing update software test scripts and released technician documentation.  Design and code software to automatically generate spacecraft test scripts.  Maintained and upgraded Golang project that collects spacecraft and test rack telemetry for status display and distribution to local network web severs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
Maintain functionality of system software and components. 
Maintain and assign software bugs to the development team.
Review proposed designs and code changes.
Implement code modifications for hardware upgrades.
Maintain SCM and software releases.
Create and deploy special releases as required.
Build and maintain operating systems computers running released software.
Troubleshoot with hardware technicians to quickly resolve component or software anomalies.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Design, code and test modifications per designed software requirements.
Update and generate documentation.
Coordinate with software users to verify modifications are understood and training is conducted.
Implement software bugs.
Check in changes to software control systems.

positions.title: Electronic Technician
positions.description: Lead Petty Officer, supervised and evaluated technicians, responsible for maintaining a constant state of readiness of over 50 different electronic systems.
